note: Designed SFX set (roadmap CP-6 audio identity), generated by tools/audio/gen_sfx.py (decisions.md D41/D46). Mono 16-bit 48 kHz PCM WAVs; pal/src/bank.rs include_bytes!s each and resamples to the device rate at stream-open (sound names are the contract with pal::bank::ASSETS). The four alert-ping cues (gunfire / unit_down / base_hit / capture) carry the going-dark alert channel (invariant #6) and must stay separable by ear. Presentation-only; regenerate with `pnpm assets:sfx`.
identity: night-ops radio: one A-minor tuning (losses fall, gains rise, confirmations sit on the root), two timbre families (noise-transient world sounds, clean-tone signal sounds), one shared SoX master chain, and deliberate >1.5 kHz content in every cue so equal-power ILD panning localizes
source: Csound 6 (seed-scripted offline synthesis) + SoX -D (shared master chain, no dither)
author: procedurally synthesised (seed-scripted) via Csound + SoX

sounds.name: gunfire
sounds.role: field weapons fire (world mix) + the TakingFire alert ping
sounds.design: distant band-limited rifle crack: 1.7 kHz noise band over a low body, fast decay

sounds.name: weapon_fire
sounds.role: the embodied avatar's OWN gun crack, host-clock on the trigger press (WS-A)
sounds.design: close hot crack: full crack + 2.6 kHz snap over a 108 Hz body thump — bigger and nearer than gunfire

sounds.name: impact
sounds.role: the avatar's shot landing — coupled to the impact VFX (WS-A)
sounds.design: very short strike: bright noise tick over a 235 Hz knock, faster decay than any crack

sounds.name: hit_confirm
sounds.role: the embodied hitmarker tick (feedback on the player's own action)
sounds.design: two rising blips E6->A6 (a rising fourth: confirmed) — the shortest, highest cue; pure UI

sounds.name: unit_down
sounds.role: one of your units died (world mix) + the UnitLost alert ping
sounds.design: FALLING three-note A-minor motif E5-C5-A4, dark tone + 4th-harmonic sparkle for pan localization

sounds.name: base_hit
sounds.role: a building of yours being hit (world mix) + the BaseUnderAttack alert ping
sounds.design: low pitched-down boom (130->55 Hz) under struck-metal inharmonic partials (742/1178/1876/2814 Hz) — the clang localizes, the boom carries weight

sounds.name: capture
sounds.role: a control point changed hands (world mix) + the TerritoryLost alert ping
sounds.design: RISING two-note chime A4->E5 with a slight inharmonic shimmer — the contour opposite of unit_down

sounds.name: production_ready
sounds.role: a queued unit finished production (command-layer confirmation)
sounds.design: single clean root blip A5 with an A6 octave sparkle — neutral 'done', neither rising nor falling
